title: Uruguayan Skillet Hot Dog
description: A classic Uruguayan-inspired hot dog recipe, cooked to perfection in a skillet with a warm and buttery crust.
instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the butter to the skillet and let it melt.
Once the butter has melted, add the frankfurter to the skillet.
Cook the frankfurter for about 5 minutes on each side, or until it's nicely browned and crispy.
While the frankfurter is cooking, add a small amount of warm water to the skillet.
This will help create a warm, buttery crust on the frankfurter.
Once the frankfurter is cooked to your liking, remove it from the skillet and place it on a plate.
Serve the frankfurter hot, garnished with your choice of toppings.
